references.text: The same chapter mentions that six hundred men from Dan went out armed with weapons of war, indicating the same group of soldiers.
The six hundred armed men continue to stand at the entrance of the gate while others go in to take the idols.
Armed men gathering at a strategic position, similar to military organization among the tribes of Israel.
The tribe of Dan was mustered and counted, showing the tribe's military strength and organization.
Armed men going before the ark show a similar military formation in Israelite tradition.
